content.text: Our photos tell stories. But not scary ghost stories. I mean, like, the stories that dreams are made of. Like when the good guys triumph, and the bad guys get caught, and the slightly-nerdy guy captures the heart of the beautiful girl who was completely unaware of said slightly-nerdy guy's feelings for her until the end of the story. These are the stories we tell.

I’ve always been drawn to the in-between moments—the quiet glances, genuine laughs, and the kind of beauty you can’t script. What started as a creative outlet quickly became a way to tell stories through light, emotion, and connection.

Whether I’m photographing a wedding, a growing family, or a personal brand session, my goal is the same: to make you feel seen and celebrated. I bring a calm, intentional energy to every shoot so you can just be yourself—and trust that I’ll capture the magic in it.
